query: How many paid vacation days do employees get per year?
source_texts: Every full-time employee receives 25 paid vacation days per calendar year.

query: Can I take vacation in December?
source_texts: The entire month of December is a company-wide black-out period: vacation requests covering December are rejected unless approved personally by the VP of Engineering.

query: How many unused vacation days can I carry over into the next year?
source_texts: Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the next calendar year; they expire on 31 March.

query: How many days per week can I work remotely?
source_texts: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week; office presence is expected on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

query: Do employees get a company laptop?
source_texts: Every employee - office, hybrid or fully remote - receives a company laptop as standard equipment.

query: What should I do if I entered my credentials on a phishing page?
source_texts: If you clicked a malicious link or entered credentials on a suspicious page: disconnect from the network and notify security@northwind.example immediately.

query: What is the per diem for business trips to Germany?
source_texts: The daily per diem for Germany is 60 EUR.

query: When do I need to submit my expense report after a business trip?
source_texts: Expense reports must be submitted in the finance portal within 14 calendar days after the end of the trip.
